prerequisites: Completion of the second study section, with at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section.
Basic knowledge of different software license models

learning_outcomes.text: Describe important areas of information technology law.
Observe important areas of information technology law in digital business models.
Recognize legally relevant problems in their professional field.
Develop solutions and implement and apply them in practice.
Understand several software license models and explain their differences.
Name and differentiate essential aspects of data protection.

syllabus_topics: Overview and classification, definition of IT law national and international
Contract conclusion and legal transaction theory, contracting parties, representation, rescission, revocation, methodology of legal finding
Types of contracts on the internet (purchase, work, service and rental agreements, and contracts of a specific kind), obligations in electronic legal transactions
Fundamentals of distance selling (important mandatory information for shops, right of revocation, digital content, fundamentals of general terms and conditions, OS platform)
Mandatory information according to TMG and DL-Info for shops, apps, social media (imprint, liability for links, "Disclaimer" for shops and sales platforms, UWG, PAngV)
Insight into domain law (allocation, trademark and naming rights, injunction, damages and information claim, court jurisdiction)
Fundamentals of copyright and Art Copyright Law - right to one's own image
Dealing with review platforms (reaction to reviews, distinction between opinion/statement of fact, deletion of reviews)
Procedural law (dunning procedure, warning letter, lawsuit and preliminary injunction) and dealing with authorities and consultants
assessment_rules: The assessment is a written examination lasting 90 minutes. No further explanations are provided.
